text: Started: R rotation tool card. Reading braindump.js for Space-for-pan prevTool shape, node model, resize handles.

Rotation working in a probe against the patched runtime: 300x200 drawing turned 90 deg keeps its centre at (550,340) and its box becomes 200x300, one Ctrl+Z restores it. Also found a live bug on the way: a drawing node has NO resize handle at all (renderNode's innerHTML wipes it, then looks for it one statement too late), so drawings could not be resized either. One extra hunk fixes it. Writing tests/board/rotation-tool.test.mjs now, port 4315.

Done. R rotation tool: 20 anchor hunks in .tmp/scratch/opus5-38/patch.json (19 JS, 1 CSS), all anchors re-verified exactly-once against the current files. New suite tests/board/rotation-tool.test.mjs, port 4372, 10 cases, geometric: bounding box trig + elementFromPoint at predicted corners, both directions. Proved red 8 ways by mutation (top-left origin, no snap, per-move history, angle stripped on save, both R-release variants, resize ignoring the angle, handle wiped) and red against the unpatched repo. test-board-basics, node-size-and-overflow, pin-move-and-snap, pin-to-viewport and 9 others green against the patched runtime in a mirror. Found two live bugs: a drawing node has NO resize handle (innerHTML wipes it), and unpinning cleared el.style.transform. Scope: text and image nodes only; iframes, markdown and nested boards refuse, reasons in notes.md. Port 4314 released.
